## Translation PR

- **Language:** [ko / ja / zh-Hans / zh-Hant / es / fr / de / pt / ru / it / ...]
- **Source commit:** [SHA of English doc this translates]
- **Checklist:**
  - [ ] Translated from latest English version (commit above)
  - [ ] Technical terms kept in English where appropriate
  - [ ] Code blocks unchanged
  - [ ] Relative links correctly point to repo root or target documents
  - [ ] Language switcher updated if adding a new language
